description: Macro oscillator on the code by Emilie Gillet, running a left and a right oscillator each with its own model: the alternative firmware for the Freak hardware module

params.text: Offsets the pitch of the left oscillator by a small amount
Sets the pitch of both oscillators
Offsets the pitch of the right oscillator by a small amount
Sets the timbre of the oscillators, and what it changes depends on the model in use
Attenuates and inverts the TIMBRE input before it is added to the TIMBRE knob
Sets the amount of amplitude or frequency modulation applied between the two oscillators
Attenuates and inverts the COLOR input before it is added to the COLOR knob
Sets the colour of the oscillators, and what it changes depends on the model in use
Steps through the models of the left oscillator, from the paired analogue waves through VOSIM, plucked and bowed strings, wavetables and clouds
Steps through the models of the right oscillator, from the paired analogue waves through VOSIM, plucked and bowed strings, wavetables and clouds
Opens the hardware's own menu on the screen

inputs.text: A trigger for the left oscillator
A trigger for the right oscillator
A control voltage added to the timbre, scaled by the TIMBRE/MOD attenuverter
Sets the pitch of the left oscillator, 1V per octave
A control voltage added to the AM/FM setting
Sets the pitch of the right oscillator, 1V per octave
A control voltage added to the colour, scaled by the COLOR/MOD attenuverter

notes: the screen menu carries the model of each oscillator, whether the outputs are mixed or separate, how the right oscillator is tuned, and a pitch calibration routine.
